text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby, where the rising
stars of the
age gather to compete. Of
course, the worthy foe
who challenged
me for the Satsuki crown is in

attendance.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
With one look at the fire in her eyes, I
sense a
potential ally in my quest to
overthrow the
Golden Generation.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Very well! I shall see if that fighting
spirit is
genuine!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
